## `neuro.number.isInteger`

Static method on `Number`.

> Returns true if the value passed is an integer, false otherwise.

## Signatures

```ts
isInteger(input: { number: unknown; prompt?: string }): Promise<boolean>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Number.isInteger` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
